<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.47.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [AdvancedLayouts] Stretch height and fixed height in vertical layouts.  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11649
### New Features 🎉
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.html by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11505
* Add config option to disable email prompt by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11395
* Add `codeFontSize` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11508
* Add `linkUnderline` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11560
* Fix UX inconsistencies between audio and camera input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11699
* Add background color to `st.metric` delta by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11678
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to st.feedback, st.pills, st.segmented_control by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11687
* Add `baseFontWeight` theming config option  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11696
* Add `dataframeHeaderBackgroundColor` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11727
* Add `codeFontWeight` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11735
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds `width="content"` option to `st.code`.  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11745
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a height parameter to `st.metric`. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11744
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameters to multiselect elements. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11730
* Hide about dialog if not explicitly set by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10091
* Add support for pandas styler font-weight in `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11705
* Apply font weight to dataframe by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11747
* Add Markdown support to `st.dialog` title by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11763
* Add support for setting a display icon in `LinkColumn` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11690
* Add `bytes` formatting option to number and progress column by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11288
* Add `chartCategoricalColors` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11734
* Add quick select to date input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10166
* Add show_time parameter to st.cache_data parameter to caching functions and tests by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11469
* Add support for setting the column config width to pixels by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11838
* Use `step` to influence column config number formatting by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11835
* Add `headingFontWeights` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11777
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a height parameters to st.text_area by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11478
* Hide "Deploy" button when file change message is showing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11834
* Make multipage section headers collapsible by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11863
* Add `headingFontSizes` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11864
* Add `chartSequentialColors` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11804
* Add support to set the value of `st.chat_input` via session state by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/10175
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* `st.set_page_config`: enable sidebar/layout configs to be None by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11664
* Bugfix(es): 3 top nav adjacent bugs we want to cherrypick into the 1.46.0 release by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11663
* Fix runtime error with event based watcher by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11692
* Display empty expanders and empty containers with a border.  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11669
* Fixed timer bug by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11756
* [fix] Resolving some regressions introduced via top nav by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11732
* Fix the `websocket_ping_interval` to be at least `websocket_ping_timeout` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11693
* [Fix] Only use `overflow: auto` when a fixed height is provided for `st.form` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11764
* Fix inline code rendering when unsafe_allow_html=True by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11817
* [fix] Fix top padding when printing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11798
* [fix] Refactor Header component to remove `isTransparentBackground` prop and adjust background logic by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11787
* [Fix] Altair/Vega/built-in charts don't stretch to full width in fullscreen mode by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11807
* [fix] Fixing the sidebar font weight and spacing for sections by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11814
* Update glide data grid to fix upstream issues by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11677
* Make dataframe error indicator adapt to sizing from theme by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11682
* Fix progress column label measurement by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11685
* Make file watcher more error-resistant by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11841
* Close column visibility menu on toolbar click by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11857
* [fix] st.multiselect placeholder ignores when options are empty by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11623
* [fix] Actually upgrade Vite to v7 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11875
* Fix code text sizing in tooltips by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11877
* Clear the script cache when all file watchers are disconnected by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11876
* [fix] No more sidebar flickering when initial_sidebar_state="collapsed" by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11861
* [Fix] Flicker on facet altair charts. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11833
* Improve file watcher exception handling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11871
* Fix initial page MPA regression by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11870
* Fix issue with missing fragment after reconnect by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11890
* Use dvh instead of vh to support dynamic changing of height. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11896
### Other Changes
* Remove stretch height from public api by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11657
* Makes st.navigation(position='top') use "stTopNavLink" instead of "stSidebarNavLink" for data-testid's by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11675
* Release/1.46.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11676
* Release/1.46.1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11783
* Type annotations for the `.clear()` method on cached functions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11793
* Make the running man icon match theme colors  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11461
* Increase StyledAppViewBlockContainer to 8rem when top nav is present by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11836
* Add application of `baseFontWeight` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11878

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11288
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11817
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11469
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11461

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.46.1...1.47.0
